paper.title: Algorithm 351: Modified Romberg Quadrature (ROMINT)
paper.venue: Communications of the ACM 12(6), June 1969, pp. 324-325 (archive header: COLLECTED ALGORITHMS FROM ACM, VOL. 12, NO. 6, June 1969, PP. 324-325). The frame lists it as TOMS 12,6; the archive header shows it is a CACM algorithm.; paper text not checked (artifact-reference claim)

claim.text: ROMINT (Romberg, EPS=1e-6, MAXE=5) on exp(-x^2) over [0, 4.3]: VAL and N in the TEST02 last row of the shipped res (VAL 0.886227, N 65). Paper value from the shipped reference (artifact-reference), VAL tol_abs 1e-5, N exact.

attempt: Built the unmodified sources (Fortran/Sp/Src/src.f, Drivers/driver.f) with make VPATH=../Src driver: the Makefile expects src.f in Drivers, the archive ships it in Src. The f77 build-tool shim (impl/f77-shim.sh, outside the source tree) maps that name and runs gfortran -std=legacy. Manifests pre, mid and post are identical (3 files compared, no change). Ran ./driver > Res. TEST02 MAXE in=5: VAL 0.886227 (shipped 0.886227), N 65 (shipped 65). The ERR column differs in the last digits in MAXE in=2 and 3 rows (0.692247E-01 vs 0.692248E-01, 0.567320E-02 vs 0.567326E-02); not a claimed value.

original_attempt.reason: make Res as the Makefile documents it stops at once: 'make: f77: No such file or directory' (exit 2). Kept in the log.
